articles.title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta after thousands of people breach Morocco’s border and at least 9 die
articles.description:
“The situation is absolute chaos,” Rachid Sbihi, head of the association that represents Spain’s Civil Guard officers who police the border in Ceuta, told The Associated Press.

The post Spain deploys military to Ceuta after thousands of people breach Morocco’s border and at least 9 die appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Spain deploys military to Ceuta amid border chaos following mass breaches from Morocco.
At least 9 people have died during the border incidents, raising humanitarian concerns.
Local authorities in Boston may face increased immigration-related challenges due to the crisis.
